additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375309-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001814] Black screen CRM:01811000235
additional_info.body:
Hello  Lorenz,
I hope this email finds you well.
Regarding your issue, could you please troubleshoot the following steps:
Check for any loose connections to the screen and board.
Check for the 24VDC supply to the Dlogic board.
Verify if the DP cables have been changed in the past with this charger. If not, we suggest replacing them with new DP cables.
If all the above steps are performed and the charger's HMI is still black even after rebooting, we suggest replacing the control panel with generation 2.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375309-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R4 170001814] Black screen CRM:01811000235
additional_info.body:
Hello Lorennz,
Greetings of the day.
We just performed a site intervention to check all the connections of HMI.
We checked 24 V power supply which we found correct.
We swapped the DPORT & USB cable with a working charger and found that cables are working.
We checked the HMI Image through remote access, and we were able to see HMI image remotely.
Please order one HMI and replace on site. Do not forger to order Sealing ring also.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
